input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "induce", "employ or engage", "hire", and "recruit" across the Agreement return no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Customer; Sections 12, 16 and 30 (the likely homes for such language) contain none. To the contrary, Section 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer has made no no-hire commitment and expressly preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and to engage any supplier. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is warranted. Note that Section 12.4 imposes a limited competitive restriction on Vendor only, which runs in our favour and is not flagged.
